questions.question: What is 'Forking' and 'Merging' in a Postman team environment?

options.A: A way to delete a collection permanently.
options.B: A version control workflow allowing developers to work on collection copies and merge changes into the main version.
options.C: A method to split the server cost between team members.
options.D: A way to duplicate an environment into two separate databases.

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'API Network' in Postman?

options.A: To measure the speed of the office Wi-Fi.
options.B: A public or private directory of discoverable APIs and collections within an organization or the world.
options.D: A list of all users who are currently using the Internet.

questions.question: How can you write a test to check if the response time is less than 500ms?

options.B: pm.response.to.be.fast(500);

questions.question: What is 'Variable Shadowing' in Postman?

options.A: When a variable is deleted by the server.
options.B: When a variable at a narrower scope (like Local) hides a variable with the same name at a broader scope (like Global).
options.C: When a variable value is encrypted.
options.D: When a variable is shared across two different workspaces.

questions.question: Which script executes if a collection runner is configured with a data file and an environment file?

options.A: Only the data file variables are used.
options.B: Only the environment file variables are used.
options.C: Both are used, but Data variables override Environment variables.
options.D: Both are used, but Environment variables override Data variables.

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'Postman Flows'?

options.A: To animate the transition between Postman tabs.
options.B: A low-code visual builder for chaining complex API sequences and data processing logic.
options.C: To monitor the flow of electricity to the server rack.
options.D: To see which team member is currently editing a request.

questions.question: How do you verify if the response is an Array using Postman BDD syntax?

options.B: pm.response.json().should.be.array();

questions.question: What is the primary role of the 'Postman Echo' service?

options.A: To improve the acoustics of the office.
options.B: A tool that returns whatever data you send it, used for testing and debugging request construction.
options.C: To duplicate requests to multiple servers simultaneously.
options.D: A backup server for Postman data.

questions.question: What does the 'pm.info' object provide in a script?

options.B: Metadata about the current request execution, such as iteration count and request name.
options.C: A list of all team member names.
options.D: The version of the operating system.

questions.question: How do you define a 'Secret' variable in a Postman Environment?

options.A: By naming the variable starting with 'SECRET_'.
options.B: By selecting 'Secret' from the variable type dropdown to mask the value in the UI.
options.C: By encrypting the text manually before pasting it into the value cell.
options.D: Secret variables are only available in the Enterprise version.

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'Mock Server Response Tagging'?

options.B: To match specific mock responses based on request headers, params, or body content.
options.C: To mark responses that should be deleted.
options.D: To show who wrote the mock response.

questions.question: Which method is used to clear all Global variables in a single command?

options.B: pm.globals.deleteAll();

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'API Builder' in Postman?

options.A: To build physical hardware for APIs.
options.B: A comprehensive tool to design, develop, test, and version APIs using specifications like OpenAPI.
options.C: To write the code for the backend server in Java.
options.D: To monitor the uptime of the Postman website.

questions.question: In a script, how do you get the number of the current iteration during a collection run?

options.B: pm.runner.count

questions.question: What is the 'Postman Interceptor' bridge used for?

options.A: To connect the Postman app to a printer.
options.B: To sync cookies and browser requests directly between Chrome and the Postman desktop app.
options.D: To translate the API response into multiple languages.

questions.question: Which assertion checks if a property 'id' is a number in a JSON response?

options.B: pm.expect(jsonData.id).to.have.type('int');

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'Private Networks' in Postman?

options.A: To provide free internet to employees.
options.B: To allow Postman cloud features (like Monitors) to securely access APIs behind a corporate firewall.
options.C: To hide API traffic from the government.
options.D: To speed up the local network.

questions.question: How do you handle 'SSL Certificate' issues for a specific request that uses a self-signed certificate?

options.A: Change the request method to POST.
options.B: Disable 'SSL certificate verification' in the request-specific or global settings.
options.C: Delete the certificate from the computer.

questions.question: What is 'API Documentation Versioning'?

options.A: Tracking the version of the Postman app.
options.B: Maintaining and publishing different versions of documentation that correspond to different API releases.
options.C: Counting the number of pages in the documentation.
options.D: A way to see which developer wrote which part of the text.

questions.question: Which script method retrieves the name of the request being currently executed?

options.B: pm.request.name

questions.question: What is 'Token Refresh' automation?

options.A: Manually typing a new token every 10 minutes.
options.B: Writing a script that detects a 401 error, calls a login endpoint, and updates the token variable automatically.
options.C: Using a token that never expires.
options.D: Restarting the Postman app to get a new token.

questions.question: Which method checks if an object is empty in a Postman test?

options.B: pm.expect(Object.keys(obj).length).to.eql(0);

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'Workspace Overview'?

options.A: To see a map of the office.
options.B: To view high-level activity, README documentation, and a summary of all items in the workspace.

questions.question: How do you perform a 'Soft Assertion' in Postman where the script continues even if a check fails?

options.A: Standard pm.test assertions are inherently 'hard'; for soft checks, use conditional logic and console.log.
options.B: Use the pm.softExpect() method.
options.C: Add a 'continue: true' flag to the test function.
options.D: Use a try-catch block around the entire test.

questions.question: What is 'Postman Desktop Agent' and why is it needed for the web version?

options.B: A local application that allows the Postman web browser version to bypass CORS and make local network requests.
options.C: A tool to clean the browser cache.

questions.question: Which feature tracks every change made to a collection by any team member?

options.B: Changelog (Collection Activity Feed)

questions.question: How can you specify the 'Newman' execution to fail if any test case within the collection fails?

options.B: --bail

questions.question: What is 'Pre-request Script Inheritance'?

options.A: When a child request inherits the scripts defined at the Folder or Collection level.
options.B: When a developer inherits a collection from a former employee.
options.C: When a script is copied from a website.
options.D: When a script is translated to Python.

questions.question: Which assertion checks if a response header 'Server' exists?

options.B: pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('Server')).to.be.true;

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'API Lifecycle' management in Postman?

options.A: To track how long the Postman app lasts on a computer.
options.B: To manage an API through design, testing, deployment, and eventual retirement phases.
options.D: To schedule the deletion of old user accounts.

questions.question: Which method allows you to generate an MD5 hash of a string in a Postman script?

options.B: CryptoJS.MD5(str).toString()

questions.question: What is 'Public API Network'?

options.B: A global directory of public APIs hosted on Postman for anyone to explore and fork.
options.C: A network that only works in libraries.
options.D: A way to share your home Wi-Fi password.

questions.question: How do you view 'Dynamic Metadata' of a request during execution?

options.B: Look at the 'Documentation' tab.
options.D: It is not possible to view metadata.

questions.question: What is 'Workspace Collaboration'?

options.B: Multiple team members working simultaneously on the same collections and environments with real-time syncing.

questions.question: Which dynamic variable returns a random status (like 'active' or 'pending')?

options.B: {{$randomProductMaterial}}
options.D: There is no built-in status variable; you must use an array and Math.random().

questions.question: What is the role of 'Postman Elements'?

options.A: The physical parts of the computer.
options.B: A set of UI components to embed Postman documentation directly into your own website.
options.C: The chemical elements of the Postman logo.
options.D: A list of all team member names.

questions.question: How do you perform 'Load Testing' in Postman (v10+)?

options.B: Using the built-in 'Performance' tab in the Collection Runner to simulate multiple virtual users.
options.D: Load testing is only possible via third-party tools like JMeter.

questions.question: What is 'Environment Forking'?

options.B: Creating a separate version of an environment to change variables without affecting the production team's version.
options.C: Splitting an environment into two different databases.
options.D: Exporting an environment to a CSV format.

questions.question: Which script method sets a Global variable?

options.B: pm.variables.setGlobal('key', 'val');

questions.question: What is 'API Security Audit' in Postman?

options.A: A person who checks your ID.
options.B: A feature that scans your API definition for security weaknesses (like exposed secrets or missing auth).
options.C: A tool to delete insecure requests.
options.D: A way to see the server's firewall logs.

questions.question: How do you access 'Cookies' for a different domain than the request URL in a script?

options.B: pm.cookies.get('domain', 'name');

questions.question: What is 'Script Debugging' in Postman?

options.B: Using console.log() and the Postman Console to inspect variable values and execution flow.

questions.question: Which Newman option saves the output to a specific JSON file?

options.B: -r json --reporter-json-export results.json

questions.question: What is 'Dynamic Request Construction'?

options.A: Building the server on the fly.
options.B: Using Pre-request scripts to modify the URL, headers, or body based on logic before the request is sent.
options.D: Building the UI as the user types.

questions.question: Which pm method returns the status text (e.g., 'OK' or 'Not Found')?

options.B: pm.response.statusText

questions.question: What is 'Collection Multi-run' (Iteration)?

options.A: Running a collection on two different computers.
options.B: Executing a collection multiple times in a row, often with different data from a CSV/JSON file.
